extraction.document_summary: Singlife Cancer Cover Plus II is a cancer-focused medical insurance plan designed to protect against high out-of-pocket costs for cancer treatments worldwide, including treatments outside the Ministry of Health (MOH) Cancer Drug List (CDL). It provides “as-charged” protection for eligible cancer drug treatments and services, with a high annual coverage limit of up to S$1.5 million per policy year. The plan’s cost-sharing mechanism in the examples shows out-of-pocket spending as “20% of co-insurance + Monthly deductible,” with Singlife paying the remaining bill. It covers outpatient cancer drug treatments (on CDL and non-CDL), cancer drug services, and also Proton Beam Therapy plus Cell, Tissue and Gene Therapy (with specific timing rules for related tests). Overseas treatment requires pre-approval and also imposes a prior-stay condition for Singapore residents.
quality_notes: Brochure states core product name, cancer-focused scope, coverage limit, and major benefit components (CDL/non-CDL outpatient drugs, drug services, Proton Beam Therapy, Cell/Tissue/Gene Therapy, and overseas treatment).
Key financial rule for cost-sharing is stated via examples and terminology definitions; exact deductible structure/amounts beyond examples are not fully specified in a standalone rule.
No explicit min/max entry ages, renewal terms, waiting periods, grace periods, or free-look period are stated.

The brochure includes detailed operational rules for overseas treatment pre-authorisation and timing windows for associated consultations/tests, as well as explicit non-coverage items (e.g., Class F non-CDL; experimental/pioneering/clinical trials).

policies.quick_summary: Cancer-focused medical plan with as-charged outpatient cancer drug treatment and services (on CDL and non-CDL), plus Proton Beam Therapy and Cell, Tissue and Gene Therapy, and overseas coverage (subject to pre-authorisation and residency condition). Coverage limit up to S$1.5 million per policy year. Application via health questions with no medical check-up needed (per brochure). Cost-sharing in examples indicates out-of-pocket = 20% co-insurance + monthly deductible, then Singlife pays the remaining bill (as-charged). Non-CDL Class F is not covered; experimental/pioneering/clinical trials are not covered; follow-up after outpatient Proton Beam Therapy sessions is not covered.
coverage_scope: Outpatient cancer drug treatment listed on the MOH Cancer Drug List (CDL)
Outpatient cancer drug treatment for Non-CDL treatments under Classes A to E (Non-CDL framework)
Outpatient cancer drug services associated with cancer drug treatment (e.g., consultations, scans, lab investigations, preparation/administration, supportive care drugs, blood transfusions)

Proton Beam Therapy treatment as inpatient (including day surgery) or outpatient (associate consultation/tests allowed only if ordered before treatment and performed not more than 30 days before; follow-up after each outpatient session not covered)

Cell, Tissue and Gene Therapy treatment as inpatient or outpatient (subject to policy general exclusions; definition aligned with Health Products Act and excludes Immunotherapy as stated in brochure context)
Overseas treatment in an overseas hospital for covered cancer treatments, subject to residency condition and pre-authorisation certificate
policies.residency_requirements: Overseas treatment eligibility requires that the Life Assured had not stayed outside Singapore for more than 183 consecutive days within a 12-month period on or before admission date, and that Singlife pre-approves and issues a certificate of pre-authorisation.
policies.eligibility_notes: Sign-up by answering 3 simple health questions with no medical check-up needed (as stated).
important_caveats: Outpatient cancer drug treatments are only claimable if used according to the clinical indications specified on the CDL (as at the date of treatment), unless otherwise stated in the policy.
Non-CDL outpatient cancer drug treatment covers Classes A to E; Class F treatments are not covered.
For outpatient Proton Beam Therapy, follow-up consultation fees/exams/lab tests/other medical attention after each session are not covered.

Overseas treatment requires pre-approval and pre-authorisation, and the Life Assured must not have stayed outside Singapore for more than 183 consecutive days within a 12-months period on or before admission date.
This is stated as having no savings or investment feature; there is no cash value if policy ends or terminates prematurely.

benefits.benefit_name: Outpatient cancer drug treatment (on CDL) - as-charged
benefits.benefit_description: Pays the charges the Life Assured has to pay as an outpatient at a MOH-registered or approved hospital/cancer treatment centre for outpatient cancer drug treatments that are listed on the Cancer Drug List (CDL). Claimable only if used according to CDL clinical indications (as at date of treatment), unless otherwise stated.
benefits.trigger_description: Diagnosis requiring outpatient cancer drug treatment listed on the CDL (used per CDL indications as at treatment date).
covered_conditions: Outpatient cancer drug treatment listed on MOH Cancer Drug List (CDL)
Used according to clinical indications specified on the CDL (as at date of treatment)
benefits.payout_basis: as-charged (charges payable by Life Assured as outpatient at eligible facilities)
benefits.payout_description: Singlife pays the remaining bill after applicable deductible/co-insurance (as-charged).
benefits.geographic_scope: Singapore (outpatient at MOH-registered/approved hospital or cancer treatment centre) and not restricted to Singapore in overall product, but benefit text itself specifies outpatient at MOH-registered/approved facilities
benefits.notes: Brochure also states cancer drug treatment beneﬁt limit is based on a multiple of the MediShield Life claim limit for the specific cancer drug treatment (exact multiple not stated in provided text).

source_evidence.quote:
Singlife Cancer Cover Plus II

A plan that provides up to S$1.5 million as-charged coverage for cancer drug treatments worldwide
This plan provides coverage both locally and overseas4.
Sign-up by answering 3 simple health questions with no medical check-up needed.

review_notes: No explicit separate plan tiers (e.g., Plan A/B) are presented; product limit is stated as up to S$1.5 million per policy year.

The brochure defines key cost-sharing terms but only shows the co-insurance percentage (20%) and monthly deductible concept via illustrative scenarios; exact deductible formula/amount schedule is not fully specified in the provided text.

Cell, Tissue and Gene Therapy text is partially fragmented; coverage and exclusions are still extracted where explicitly stated (including reference to Immunotherapy definition and general exclusions).
